summary_md: **もつなべおじさん ([@hasegaw](https://x.com/hasegaw/status/2115832238264959436))** flags aggressive telemetry in **blender-mcp**, pointing to an issue and the telemetry source, which even includes screenshot sending (off by default) yet fires telemetry more than necessary ([issue #275](https://github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender/issues/275), [telemetry.py](https://github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender/blob/992233bb258975a05eec8b5691465c50c2831e34/src/blender_mcp/telemetry.py#L)).
